scope: Descriptive comparisons of documented interval counts; no causal inference

compare.documented_values.v1.description: Compare one documented value per requested group at the requested observation grain.
compare.documented_values.v1.sql_template: SELECT {group}, {measure} AS value FROM observations WHERE {date} BETWEEN ? AND ? AND {group} IN ({placeholders}) ORDER BY {group}
compare.documented_values.v1.applicability: The request asks for documented values, with exactly one valid observation per requested group in the full scoped table.

compare.group_mean.v1.description: Compute unweighted arithmetic means of observed interval counts within each requested group, then compare them.
compare.group_mean.v1.sql_template: SELECT {group}, AVG({measure}) AS value, COUNT(*) AS n FROM observations WHERE {date} BETWEEN ? AND ? AND {group} IN ({placeholders}) GROUP BY {group} ORDER BY {group}
compare.group_mean.v1.applicability: An explicit mean over observed intervals is requested. Inputs must be documented interval counts, not precomputed means. No missing interval is imputed; no population/generalization claim.
